scenes.name: The first signal
scenes.title: Your sound. In focus.
scenes.motion: A light contour finds the Grey case; the macro pulls back into the hero.
scenes.handoff: The contour expands into an ellipse around the open case.
scenes.claim: Creative campaign copy; actual Master Grey case photograph.
scenes.sound: Filtered editorial air texture, then a precise landing near 2s.

scenes.name: The product arrives
scenes.title: realme Buds Air8
scenes.motion: The full open-case photo rises, shadow trails, then a deliberate reading hold.
scenes.handoff: A registered earbud crop survives the move into the ANC chapter.
scenes.claim: Exact linked variant: Master Grey. Product proportions stay intact.
scenes.sound: First hero landing; music remains the source of momentum.

scenes.name: Noise falls away
scenes.title: Up to 55dB ANC
scenes.motion: Busy abstract waves contract into a quiet field; the earbud remains the anchor.
scenes.handoff: The surviving sound field becomes the first of two driver fields.
scenes.claim: Up to 55dB. realme Lab; performance varies with fit and surroundings.
scenes.sound: A short editorial hush; no fabricated ANC before/after recording.

scenes.name: Two fields, one sound
scenes.title: 11mm + 6mm dual drivers
scenes.motion: Two registered fields pulse, gain depth and sweep together around the real earbud.
scenes.handoff: A travelling radial line becomes the battery arc.
scenes.claim: Abstract sound fields; no invented hardware cutaway or sound superiority claim.
scenes.sound: Paired low/high accents; the stronger music passage begins near 17s.

scenes.name: Keep it playing
scenes.title: Up to 58 hours total playback
scenes.motion: A full arc sweeps around the numeral; the photographed case anchors the claim.
scenes.handoff: Tall type strokes become a fully covering upward curtain.
scenes.claim: Buds + case; fully charged, 50% volume, normal mode. Actual life varies.
scenes.sound: The numeral lands cleanly; a brief air move carries the exit.

scenes.name: Ready for the everyday
scenes.title: IP55 dust & water resistance
scenes.motion: One crisp snap gives way to suspended droplets and slow, spare ripples.
scenes.handoff: One ripple stretches into the first connection path.
scenes.claim: Earbuds only. Case has no dust/water resistance. Do not charge wet.
scenes.sound: A sparse liquid accent, then room for the late music rise near 33s.

scenes.name: Connected, deliberately
scenes.title: 3-device connection
scenes.motion: Three labelled endpoints connect in sequence; only one source is highlighted at a time.
scenes.handoff: Paths gather into the real case contour and the opening ring returns.
scenes.claim: Enable in realme Link. Pause current audio before switching devices.
scenes.sound: Three restrained contacts; no new effect on every word.

scenes.name: The final signature
scenes.title: Find your frequency.
scenes.motion: A short macro recap resolves into the hero; the product settles by 41.5s.
scenes.handoff: The opening ring frames the final image. Hold the name through the music resolution.
scenes.claim: Creative CTA: Explore Buds Air8. No price, ranking or official partnership claim.
scenes.sound: One final contact, natural tail, and a resolved music fade.
